encodedlogistics:rack_elevation_copy.title: Crafting Table (copy a Rack Elevation)
encodedlogistics:rack_elevation_copy.text: A written Rack Elevation and a blank one make two written copies of the same plan. The original stays in the grid, as a written book's does when it's copied.

encodedlogistics:rack_elevation_clear.title: Crafting Table (clear a Rack Elevation)
encodedlogistics:rack_elevation_clear.text: A written Rack Elevation on its own in the grid goes back to a blank one.

encodedlogistics:tape_upgrade.text: The new tape takes the old one's identity, so it keeps everything stored on it. Its fill is worked out again once it's back in a Tape Library.

minecraft:crafting_dye.text: Dyes tint the Swivel Chair's fabric, and several dyes mix as they do on leather armour.
